name: GT7 ULTRA MAX Smart Watch with Two 2 Straps Band Wireless Charging
description:
LAXASFIT GT7 Ultra Max Smart Watch – Key Features:

Plastic body 

1.9/2.0 inch HD Display

Bluetooth Calling Support

Heart Rate, Blood Oxygen, and Sleep Monitoring

Multi-Sports Mode

Long Battery Backup (2–5 days)

Notification Alerts (Calls, Messages, Social Apps)

Extra Colorful Strap & Charging Cable
